We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 1914385) to the given molecule (initial_molecule SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O). The template search gave mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to apply the template to the molecule to get precursors. Use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles and template_id.

Let's call apply_template.
